name: Migration selloff reclaim
hypothesis: Buy only after the post-migration low holds and executable price reclaims the migration reference.
spec: Setup: Mechanical transition selling may temporarily overshoot sustainable demand. Entry: Buy only after the post-migration low holds and executable price reclaims the migration reference. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit below that low or at the preselected recovery target. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs launchpad migration events and pool state history (on-chain, not connected)
